name: How should I prepare my home before shower demolition starts?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before shower demolition starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: A replacement should include a clear plan for shutting off water, protecting adjacent rooms, isolating dust, and securing the bathroom between work periods. Context: Demolition can expose open plumbing, sharp materials, and damp substrates, while households may still need to pass through the area. Key factors: children and pets; alternate bathroom access; floor protection; temporary barriers; material storage; and daily cleanup. Practical guidance: Remove personal items, protect valuables, and agree on access rules before work begins. Ask Elite Remodeling & Design how the work zone will be contained and what condition the bathroom will be left in each day.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove bathroom items, clear access routes, protect valuables, plan for water shutoffs, and arrange another bathroom if needed. Ask about dust barriers, floor protection, debris storage, daily cleanup, pet or child restrictions, and how exposed plumbing or unfinished surfaces will be secured overnight.
